Planning with Confidence in the COVID-19 Era Report
To help your institution plan with confidence amid COVID-19, this report <[[https://flywire.drift.click/planning-with-confidence?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=planning%20with%20confidence%20report]]> addresses key policies, best practices, and flexible solutions for Fall 2020 Student Enrollment. Key topics include:
- Driving Enrollment & Initial Payments - Affordability & Payment Plans - Addressing Visa Requirements - Ensuring a Seamless Payment Process
